response.message: Free trial used (3/3 calls for this client). Continue on the paid x402 endpoints.

trial_usage.counting: per X-Trial-Client header, or per client IP when the header is absent

response.how_to_continue: POST the same JSON body to the matching paid path. That endpoint answers HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base, eip155:8453); settle it with an x402-capable client and the call returns HTTP 200.
